name: How can a local real estate agent assist with a 1031 exchange in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: How can a local real estate agent assist with a 1031 exchange in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: A knowledgeable local real estate agent, like those at Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution, can be invaluable in a 1031 exchange in South Florida. They can help identify suitable 'like-kind' replacement properties within the strict 45-day deadline, leveraging their deep understanding of markets like Miami-Dade, Broward, or Palm Beach County. They can also assist with accurate property valuations for both relinquished and replacement properties, connect you with qualified intermediaries and tax professionals, and navigate the complexities of contracts and negotiations specific to investment properties in the region.
acceptedAnswer.description: A local real estate agent can help identify 'like-kind' replacement properties within deadlines, provide valuations, and connect you with qualified intermediaries in South Florida.
